description: Defines classes and structures for WebM media elements, including serialization and specific element types like header, segment info, tracks, cue points, and blocks, used in WebM media processing within Android.

classes.name: WebmElement
classes.description: Base class for WebM media elements, providing serialization and size calculation functionalities.

classes.name: WebmUnsigned
classes.description: Represents an unsigned integer WebM element.

classes.name: WebmBinary
classes.description: Represents a binary WebM element, typically referencing media data.

classes.name: WebmSimpleBlock
classes.description: Represents a simple block of media data within WebM.

classes.name: EbmlVoid
classes.description: Represents a void element used for padding or placeholders.

classes.name: WebmMaster
classes.description: Container element that holds multiple WebM sub-elements.

methods.name: serializePayloadSize
methods.description: Serializes the size of the payload into a buffer.

methods.name: serializePayload
methods.description: Serializes the payload data into a buffer.

methods.name: totalSize
methods.description: Calculates total size of the WebM element.

methods.name: serializeInto
methods.description: Serializes the WebM element into a buffer.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the WebM element and returns a buffer with its data.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes the WebM element to a file descriptor.
